connector.name: Skia Studio
connector.registryDescription: MCP bridge to a live Skia Studio tab: AGSL/SkSL shader authoring, graph editing, screenshots.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package skia-studio-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the lixiaolin94 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: SKIA_STUDIO_BRIDGE_PORT
env.description: Override the local ws bridge port (default 8787; pair with the web app ?bridgePort= param).

env.name: SKIA_STUDIO_EXTRA_ORIGINS
env.description: Comma-separated extra hostnames appended to the WebSocket Origin allowlist.

env.name: SKIA_STUDIO_APP_URL
env.description: Override the app URL suggested when no browser tab is connected.
